predecessors.name: Seleucid Empire
predecessors.text: 'Media and Persis revolted under their governors'

successors.name: Seleucid Empire
successors.text: Media and Persis, recovered when 'the rebellion of Molon and Alexander collapsed' in 221

ledger.x: 222: Molon and Alexander rise in Media and Persis against the new king, Antiochus III.
221: the revolt collapses and Antiochus III recovers Media and Persis.
221: the rebel regime ends with the collapse of the revolt.

wars.name: Revolt of Molon
wars.outcome: Antiochus III suppresses the revolt; Media and Persis return to Seleucid rule.

certainty.note: The extent of the rebel domain is the two provinces the page names; no frontier is given.
